title: Unexplored Flaws in Multiple-Choice VQA Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on multiple-choice VQA datasets using 48 distinct prompt permutations (varying option ID sets, option delimiters, and option separators) and measuring variations in model accuracy, coverage, and benchmark rankings.

Using a circular evaluation scheme that systematically shifts the answer options in the prompt to measure the models' answering frequency for each option position, thereby detecting inherent preferences for specific spatial or alphabetical positions.
